gotchas: americanairlines.com redirects to aa.com. From a non-US connection the site serves a localized page; add ?locale=en_US.
A OneTrust consent wall covers the page on first load and intercepts clicks; dismiss it first.

One page: name, date of birth, gender (combobox), address (country/state comboboxes), email + confirm, phone (type and calling-code comboboxes), then 'Create account'. No password field on this form; it was not submitted, so how the password is set was not observed.
Date of birth: type the digits into input[placeholder*="MM"]. Gender: selectOption by label timed out; selecting by index worked.
Type the email and confirmEmail key by key and Tab out; the + address is accepted.

Submitted 2026-10-02: the form is replaced by a welcome / check-your-email screen, and AA emails the account owner a temporary password. The vault-minted password is not the account's password until the owner signs in with the emailed one and changes it.

passwordSetBySite: AA emails a temporary password after signup; the vault-minted password is never set on the account, so sign-in with tokens.password fails ('Check your login information and try again.') until the owner sets the emailed password on the login.
